changelog:
- Initial release of the model-usage skill.
- Summarizes per-model usage cost from CodexBar CLI logs for Codex or Claude.
- Supports reporting for the current (most recent) model or a full breakdown of all models.
- Accepts provider selection and input via file, stdin, or by running CodexBar CLI.
- Output available in text (default) or JSON format.
